recentItems.title: KWK 9: Rashmika Mandanna Picks Allu Arjun Over Ranbir Kapoor, Vijay REVEALS Marriage Proposal Story
recentItems.description:

Vijay claims Rashmika asked him to marry her 100 times, leaving Karan Johar surprised. The couple also shares hilarious moments as Vijay reveals his funny rule about married life.
